dialogue.context: Existing dialogue. Before asking for help finding the shuttle.
dialogue.text: Sella: A net is mostly holes held in the right places. This one has ambitions.

description: Sella mends nets. Her missing wooden shuttle belonged to her brother, who lost two fingers to a winch and taught himself the work again. She resists turning his injury into an entertaining story for the ring crowd: he mostly called it inconvenient. Returning the shuttle earns his much-repaired scarf, which still does its work. Neither his current whereabouts nor his death is established.

links.description: Teaches Pell to undo and explain what holds a knot before accepting his work; the finished net must safely bear a person’s weight.
